mapper.select: SELECT share_id, note_id, note_version, author_id, share_time, expire_time, access_type, access_password, share_token, is_active, access_count FROM note_shares WHERE share_id = #{shareId}

SELECT share_id, note_id, note_version, author_id, share_time, expire_time, access_type, access_password, share_token, is_active, access_count FROM note_shares WHERE share_id = #{shareId} AND share_token = #{shareToken}

SELECT share_id, note_id, note_version, author_id, share_time, expire_time, access_type, access_password, share_token, is_active, access_count FROM note_shares WHERE note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY share_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_shares (share_id, note_id, note_version, author_id, share_time, expire_time, access_type, access_password, share_token, is_active, access_count) VALUES (#{shareId}, #{noteId}, #{noteVersion}, #{authorId}, #{shareTime}, #{expireTime}, #{accessType}, #{accessPassword}, #{shareToken}, #{active}, #{accessCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE note_shares SET note_version = #{noteVersion}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, access_type = #{accessType}, access_password = #{accessPassword}, is_active = #{active} WHERE share_id = #{shareId}
